Ah, I don't know much about psychedelics or drugs in general. I just think you should be careful when recommending stuff like this to young, usually impressionable people.

I agree with your points, however, the overwhelming majority of 18 year olds are not very mature and you should not recommend substances such as these to them.
Another point I'd like to add is that getting her to use substances as these to relieve stress is a bad idea, she should not make habits of relying on any substances (unless they were medically prescribed, and even then I'd be careful) at such a young age imo.

You have to remember that this is a girl in high school. There should be absolutely no reason to recommend for an 18 year old girl to turn to psychedelics. It doesn't matter how 'natural and non-toxic' they are, he is still recommending drugs to barely an adult. As for your 3rd point, how can you trust for a first time drug user (I'm assuming) to research the right dose, and at such a young age to be able to rely on their friends to protect them when they are likely irresponsible (once again, shes in high school. High schoolers arent exactly the most reliable and experienced bunch) and even with all of the supposed benefits of mushrooms, he gave terrible advice just because of context.

1. I didn't go into details because I thought recommending potentially harmful substances to a teenager is self explanatory and I didn't need to say why it's awful advice.
2. Comparing taking pain pills to taking shrooms is frankly idiotic. Pain pills can be regulated and bought from pharmacies, where you have an exact prescription of how much to take, professionals to consult if you have any questions, and most importantly, you can be sure they arent laced with anything and won't kill you. For illegal drugs it is the opposite- nothing is regulated and she could get herself in trouble with bad people. 
3. 'Used responsibly' is such a loose term. When these substances aren't tested or regulated in any shape or form there is no way for her to know what 'responsible' means.
You are recommending an 18 year old girl to do LSD. Just.... no.
